components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.75rem; min-height:46px; padding:0 1.2rem; color:var(--white, #fff); background:var(--ink, #11131a); border:1px solid var(--ink, #11131a); border-radius:999px; font-family:var(--body, "Inter Variable", sans-serif); font-size:.78rem; font-weight:580; text-decoration:none; transition:color 240ms ease, background 240ms ease, transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary svg { width:18px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { color:var(--ink, #11131a); background:transparent; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--violet, #6d56a8); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; min-height:84px; padding:0 3.5vw; color:var(--ink, #11131a); background:var(--porcelain, #f2f0ea); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, rgba(17,19,26,.18)); font-family:var(--body, "Inter Variable", sans-serif); } .ds-wordmark { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:.52rem; color:inherit; font-family:var(--display, "Inter Variable", sans-serif); font-size:1.04rem; font-weight:620; letter-spacing:-.025em; text-decoration:none; } .ds-wordmark span:last-child { color:var(--violet, #6d56a8); font-weight:450; } .ds-nav-links { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2rem; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:520; } .ds-nav-links a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-action { padding:.8rem 1.2rem; color:#fff !important; background:var(--ink, #11131a); border:1px solid var(--ink, #11131a); border-radius:999px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--violet, #6d56a8); outline-offset:4px; }

components.css: .ds-voice-card { max-width:620px; padding:clamp(2rem,4vw,4rem); color:var(--ink, #11131a); background:var(--porcelain, #f2f0ea); border-radius:16px; box-shadow:24px 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.22); font-family:var(--body, "Inter Variable", sans-serif); } .ds-voice-state { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.65rem; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:630; } .ds-voice-state span { width:8px; height:8px; background:var(--teal-dark, #137a74); border-radius:50%; } .ds-wave { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:110px; margin:2.5rem 0; } .ds-wave i { width:8px; height:34%; background:linear-gradient(to top, var(--teal, #2ebcaf), var(--lilac, #9d83cd)); border-radius:999px; } .ds-wave i:nth-child(2n) { height:68%; } .ds-wave i:nth-child(3n) { height:92%; } .ds-transcript { display:grid; grid-template-columns:4rem 1fr; gap:1.2rem 1rem; padding-top:1.5rem; border-top:1px solid var(--line, rgba(17,19,26,.18)); } .ds-transcript small { color:var(--muted-ink, #5a5d65); font-size:.7rem; font-weight:650; } .ds-transcript p { margin:0; font-family:var(--display, "Inter Variable", sans-serif); font-size:1.25rem; line-height:1.35; } .ds-transcript .ds-response { color:var(--violet, #6d56a8); } .ds-voice-card:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--violet, #6d56a8); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Acoustic Specimen
components.description: The circular product-presence motif: living material held inside opposing measurement rings.
components.html: PULSE / 001
components.css: .ds-orb-stage { position:relative; width:min(340px,80vw); aspect-ratio:1; isolation:isolate; } .ds-orb-stage::after { position:absolute; z-index:-1; right:8%; bottom:4%; left:8%; height:14%; content:""; background:rgba(55,47,73,.16); border-radius:50%; filter:blur(24px); } .ds-orb { position:absolute; inset:9%; border-radius:50%; background:conic-gradient(from 145deg, var(--teal, #2ebcaf), #d8d3e2 36%, var(--lilac, #9d83cd), var(--teal, #2ebcaf)); box-shadow:0 28px 48px rgba(49,43,63,.12); } .ds-ring { position:absolute; border:1px solid rgba(17,19,26,.23); border-radius:50%; } .ds-ring::before { position:absolute; width:7px; height:7px; content:""; background:var(--ink, #11131a); border-radius:50%; } .ds-ring-outer { inset:0; } .ds-ring-outer::before { top:-4px; left:49%; } .ds-ring-inner { inset:5%; border-color:rgba(109,86,168,.35); } .ds-ring-inner::before { bottom:10%; left:16%; background:var(--violet, #6d56a8); } .ds-orb-label { position:absolute; right:3%; bottom:6%; color:var(--violet, #6d56a8); font-family:var(--body, "Inter Variable", sans-serif); font-size:.58rem; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:.13em; } .ds-orb-stage:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--violet, #6d56a8); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
Pulse is intelligence given presence: quiet enough to invite attention, exact enough to feel credible, and materially expressive enough to be remembered. The system borrows the measured confidence of an instrument dossier—porcelain fields, ink typography, fine specimen marks, and circular acoustic forms—without becoming clinical or cold.

Teal and lilac behave like living material inside this disciplined frame. They signal voice, response, and intelligence in motion while the surrounding interface remains restrained. The result explicitly refuses the generic dark-neon AI dashboard: darkness is a deliberate contrast field, never the default atmosphere, and luminous color is used as evidence of activity rather than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Porcelain-first surfaces with precise ink structure
Expansive, tightly set display typography paired with neutral body copy
Teal-to-lilac material reserved for voice, signal, and response
Circular specimen geometry, fine rules, and sparse measurement marks
Flat-by-default composition with selective object-like lift
Slow, measured motion that yields completely to reduced-motion preferences

rules.name: The Living Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal, lilac, and violet must communicate voice, response, focus, or material presence; they are not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Porcelain Majority Rule
rules.body: Warm neutral fields remain the dominant visual atmosphere. Dark sections are deliberate contrast events, not the system's default mode.

rules.name: The Short Monument Rule
rules.body: Display lines are large because they are brief. Do not use monumental type for paragraphs or let it expand into generic full-width slogans.

rules.name: The Case Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Uppercase belongs to measurement, state, and taxonomy; lowercase preserves the elchai brand voice.

rules.name: The Ruled Space Rule
rules.body: Use hairlines, grid proportions, and controlled whitespace to establish structure before introducing containers.

rules.name: The Object-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to tangible focal specimens and active signals. Structural sections, rails, and ordinary content remain flat.

rules.name: The Circle Means Presence Rule
rules.body: Circles identify the product's voice, listening state, or measured object—not arbitrary decoration.

dos: Do let porcelain, ink, and whitespace carry most of the interface.
Do reserve chromatic material for voice, response, focus, and product presence.
Do use one-pixel rules and asymmetric grids before reaching for cards.
Do preserve oversized type and object scale on mobile while simplifying the sequence around them.
Do provide still, legible fallbacks and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do keep the elchai and elchai pulse names lowercase.
donts: Don't turn the system into a generic dark-neon AI dashboard.
Don't cover every section in rounded cards, glass panels, or decorative gradients.
Don't use circles unless they signify presence, listening, signal, or measurement.
Don't apply shadows to ordinary sections, navigation, or list rows.
Don't use uppercase as a general brand voice; reserve it for functional specimen language.
Don't add visual claims, badges, benchmarks, or proof motifs that the product cannot substantiate.
